data.narrative:
Slip Robotics is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $44M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (Bedrock Robotics at $1.8B Series B, Dexterity at $1.6B Series B, Hadrian at $1.6B Series C, and Nimble Robotics at $1.0B Series C), supplemented by a broader universe of 8 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis uses the $44M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B progression, yielding $84M. Peer-median analysis applies the median valuation of the four selected comparables at $1.6B, reflecting market multiples for companies at this stage in the robotics sector. The peer range spans $1.0B to $1.8B.

The triangulated analysis implies a valuation range of $71M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $854M. The wide spread reflects tension between precedent transaction multiples (stage-progression) and current peer-set valuations (peer-median). Key uncertainties include whether Slip's capital efficiency, product differentiation, and addressable market warrant peer-level multiples versus a discount reflective of earlier-stage risk, and whether the peer set—dominated by later-stage rounds—appropriately anchors early Series B positioning.
